requirements.quote: Endpoints that send data using IPv6 SHOULD apply an IPv6 flow label in compliance with [RFC6437], unless the local API does not allow setting IPv6 flow labels.
requirements.condition: An endpoint sends data using IPv6 and its local API allows IPv6 flow labels to be set.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply an IPv6 flow label in compliance with RFC6437.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can observe whether outbound IPv6 packets carry a flow label when the API supports setting one; full RFC6437 compliance requires the referenced specification.

requirements.quote: The flow label generation MUST be designed to minimize the chances of linkability with a previously used flow label, as a stable flow label would enable correlating activity on multiple paths; see Section 9.5.
requirements.condition: An endpoint generates IPv6 flow labels, including after a path or observable-identifier change.
requirements.required_behavior: Design flow-label generation to minimize the chance that a generated label can be linked with a previously used flow label.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a stable flow label in a way that enables activity on multiple paths to be correlated.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation review and repeated flow-label generation tests can determine whether labels remain stable or otherwise expose a linkable relationship across paths.
